prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE 16:9 landscape full-frame narrative illustration, gentle pencil and watercolor.
MANDATORY REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image 1 is the highest-priority identity and drawing reference. Preserve its 2.6-head-tall childlike figure, simple broad ROUND face with full cheeks and a SHORT ROUND chin, small simple nose and mouth, pale grey-white short hair in broad simple tufts with thick green tips, grey-black over-ear headphones with green rings, plain forest-green pullover hoodie with kangaroo pocket, grey shorts and bare feet. Preserve Image 1's delicate, low-density pencil lines and soft watercolor character handling. Image 2 is ONLY an eye-completion reference: open ROUND eyes with olive irises, dark pupils, small highlights and visible eye whites. Do not inherit its pose or scene. Image 3 is the approved eye-completed simple round-face style, plus the same cream accordion-fold paper map with pictorial green hills, a soft blue stream and ochre route; do NOT inherit Image 3's village setting or standing pose. Never make the face pointed, eyes long or narrow, hair spiky with many fine strands, or clothes densely patterned.
SCENE: A calm bright library reading corner by a tall window, a low wooden bookshelf filled with books with warm muted russet, terracotta, sage and blue spines, a soft round pale sage rug on natural pale wood flooring. Soft blue-green daylight through window with leafy trees outside, balanced cream walls and warm wood, natural lavender-blue shadows. No dark yellow tint. Cozy but not cluttered. The character sits ON THE FLOOR by the rug and low shelves, no desk or table. A few small pale cream sticky notes and one or two old notebooks lie naturally nearby on the rug. All architecture and floor extend naturally to the canvas edges and bottom; no empty poster background or blank subtitle strip.
PROP AND ANATOMY: Same cream map with three folded sections, delicate hand-drawn hills, a blue river, a continuous ochre route, and no letters or labels. All paper sits on lap/rug or is physically held, never floats. Show exactly two arms and two hands with natural wrists and finger joints, and coherent bent legs/cross-legged posture. Bare feet if visible must connect plausibly to legs.
COMPOSITION: Face, hands, map and important paper relationships must stay in the central area above y=75% image height. Foreground natural wooden floor and rug continue through the lowest 25%, preserving subtitle clearance without a blank band. Eye-level or gently elevated three-quarter camera keeps face visible and hands legible.
AVOID: no text, Chinese, words, numbers, scores, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, floating cards, diagram overlays, screens, labels, collage, desk, triumphant gestures, guarantees of success or evaluation grades. No literal question mark glyph; paper drawings are non-textual short soft lines and small dots only. No anime-rendered sharp face, excessive highlights, dense hatch marks or fabric ornament.
SHOT 5 — SELECT A NOTE AND CONNECT IT TO THE MAP.
Image 4 is the preceding library shot. Use it ONLY to preserve the exact window/shelf/rug location, sunlight, cream map, old notebook and scattered note props. Images 1–3 remain authoritative for character identity and simple round facial structure. This shot must show a REAL CHANGE in hands, paper placement and gaze, not merely a cropped version of Image 4.
A moderately closer medium shot, camera shifted slightly toward the character's right and mildly higher so hands and papers are visible, while face remains visible. Same character remains seated on the rug with coherent cross-legged lower body. The map is now laid OPEN and relatively flat over the knees and the rug directly in front, freeing both hands.
CLEAR SPECIFIC ACTION: The character's left hand at camera-right has taken ONE small cream note from the scattered notes and is just placing it on the rug directly BESIDE the right edge of the open map, its bottom edge touching down, fingers pinching its top corner naturally. That selected note has only one very simple ochre curved short stroke with a small separate dot, an informal non-letter sketch with no precise question-mark glyph. The character's right hand at camera-left reaches across a little and uses the index fingertip to touch one particular route junction on the map beside the selected note. Show the fingertip visibly meeting the ochre route, not hovering. The other fingers curl naturally. Exactly two hands; no extra hand holding the map. Character gaze focuses thoughtfully on where the finger touches, with a quiet small expression of understanding, full round cheeks, short round chin and both round olive eyes visible. No victory smile or gesture.
Place the hand-note-map relationship centrally at y=53%–72%, comfortably above the subtitle zone. The selected note and pointed route are close enough for viewers to see their connection. The remaining two notes and old notebook stay nearby to the right as context, no floating cards or imposed graphics. Natural rug and warm wood fill the foreground to the bottom edge. Window daylight stays fresh pale blue-green, colored book spines stay warm but restrained. No table. No words, labels, numbers, arrows added outside the map, speech balloons, watermarks, graphic UI, or success symbol.

targeted_revision.prompt:
Edit Image 4 with ONE targeted fix: move the IMPORTANT MAP + TWO HANDS + SELECTED NOTE relationship UP from the bottom foreground to the character's lap, so subtitles cannot cover it. Keep the exact round-face character, bright library, window, bookshelves, palette, rug, cross-legged sitting and gentle watercolor style. Images 1–3 are the mandatory character references: original Image 1 round face/body first, Image 2 only olive eyes, Image 3 approved completed face and cream map. Do not change identity or scene.
Currently the open map reaches y=93%, too low. Corrected map must rest open across the crossed thighs/lap directly in front of the torso, with its upper edge at y=55%, lower edge at y=75%, roughly camera-facing at a gentle shallow incline. The crossed legs support the paper; it must not float. Bend both elbows naturally so the pointing fingertip meets the same route junction at about y=66–68%, and the other hand lowers the small selected cream note at the map's right edge at about y=66–70%, held lightly by its top corner. Preserve the selected note's simple small ochre curved route/dots with NO text. Exactly two arms and two anatomically continuous hands; pointing index meets the route, other fingers naturally curled. The specific action is one hand PLACING a note beside the map while the other POINTS to the related route. Character calmly looks at that route, broad round cheeks and short rounded chin retained. Keep coherent seated legs and two feet if visible. Keep the rest of foreground as natural rug and wood through the bottom edge. Other secondary notes/notebook may remain at floor level. No table, text, labels, watermark, floating graphic, extra limbs, or blank footer. 16:9 landscape.

inspection.identity: round face/short round chin, olive eyes, green hair tips and headphones retained
inspection.action: one hand places selected note beside map on lap; other index finger points at route junction; two hands/two crossed bare feet coherent; no extra hand
inspection.composition: map and key hand-note relationship now around y=52-73%; bottom floor/rug natural; no literal question mark or text generated
